# Merge Similar Items. Rows of the result are [label, total weight], by label.

@example Label 9 is in both lists, so its weights add up to 4 + 6 = 10; labels 1, 3 and 5 are each in one list only.
[[5,2],[1,7],[9,4]]
[[9,6],[3,3]]
=> [[1,7],[3,3],[5,2],[9,10]]

@example Both lists have labels 2 and 4, in different orders: rows go together by label, not by position.
[[2,10],[4,1]]
[[4,9],[2,5]]
=> [[2,15],[4,10]]

@example No label is shared, so both rows come through, ordered by label.
[[1000,3]]
[[1,1000]]
=> [[1,1000],[1000,3]]

# One row in each list, with the same label.
[[7,1]]
[[7,1]]
=> [[7,2]]

# Both lists sorted from the largest label down.
[[9,1],[6,2],[3,3]]
[[8,4],[6,5],[1,6]]
=> [[1,6],[3,3],[6,7],[8,4],[9,1]]

# The largest label is only in items1.
[[1,1],[2,2],[50,5]]
[[2,3]]
=> [[1,1],[2,5],[50,5]]

# The largest label is only in items2.
[[4,4]]
[[10,1],[4,4],[2,2],[30,9]]
=> [[2,2],[4,8],[10,1],[30,9]]

# No label shared, labels interleaved: more rows than either list has.
[[2,1],[6,1],[4,1]]
[[5,2],[1,2],[3,2]]
=> [[1,2],[2,1],[3,2],[4,1],[5,2],[6,1]]

# Labels 1 and 1000, and two weights of 1000 adding up to 2000.
[[1000,1000],[1,1]]
[[1000,1000]]
=> [[1,1],[1000,2000]]

# Sorted by label, not by weight.
[[3,9],[8,1]]
[[5,4]]
=> [[3,9],[5,4],[8,1]]

# A short items1 and a longer items2 with nothing in common.
[[500,1]]
[[1,1],[999,2],[2,3],[1000,4]]
=> [[1,1],[2,3],[500,1],[999,2],[1000,4]]

# Longer lists (10 and 9 rows), neither sorted, with four shared labels.
[[14,3],[2,8],[19,1],[7,7],[11,2],[5,6],[16,4],[1,9],[9,5],[12,1]]
[[6,2],[16,5],[3,3],[11,8],[20,1],[1,1],[13,4],[7,2],[18,6]]
=> [[1,10],[2,8],[3,3],[5,6],[6,2],[7,9],[9,5],[11,10],[12,1],[13,4],[14,3],[16,9],[18,6],[19,1],[20,1]]

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
[[500,990],[738,8],[84,7]]
[[84,1]]
=> [[84,8],[500,990],[738,8]]

@gen 2 small
[[398,6],[77,7],[17,1],[923,995],[891,990]]
[[619,5],[891,3],[17,992]]
=> [[17,993],[77,7],[398,6],[619,5],[891,993],[923,995]]

@gen 3 small
[[933,1],[850,7],[822,6],[524,4],[443,7],[271,9]]
[[850,4],[271,4],[524,3],[443,1],[933,995]]
=> [[271,13],[443,8],[524,7],[822,6],[850,11],[933,996]]

@gen 4 small
[[997,3],[992,5]]
[[998,995],[999,9],[994,999],[997,9],[996,5]]
=> [[992,5],[994,999],[996,5],[997,12],[998,995],[999,9]]

@gen 5 small
[[1000,8],[998,999],[999,3],[997,7]]
[[998,5],[996,1000]]
=> [[996,1000],[997,7],[998,1004],[999,3],[1000,8]]

@gen 6 small
[[997,1],[996,1],[994,1],[999,7]]
[[996,8],[1000,1],[995,7],[997,4]]
=> [[994,1],[995,7],[996,9],[997,5],[999,7],[1000,1]]

@gen 11 small
[[7,9],[4,991],[3,4],[1,4],[5,6]]
[[3,8]]
=> [[1,4],[3,12],[4,991],[5,6],[7,9]]

@gen 13 small
[[5,6],[2,8],[3,5]]
[[6,2],[2,2],[3,991]]
=> [[2,10],[3,996],[5,6],[6,2]]
